# NinjaSRE

> A self-hosted AI SRE platform that investigates production incidents, produces
> evidence-backed root causes, learns from every run, and measures continuously
> whether that learning helps. Nothing leaves the operator's infrastructure:
> no telemetry, no analytics, no crash reporting, and no hosted control plane.

Apache-2.0. Python 3.12+. One PostgreSQL instance carrying `pgvector` and Apache
AGE is the only required datastore; every LLM provider is an optional extra, so a
deployment running a local model installs none of them and is fully functional.

The system's non-negotiables, each enforced by something in `make verify` rather
than asserted: evidence over assertion; bounded autonomy with every ceiling a
named constant; read-only by default with per-action approval and a stored
rollback plan above that; secrets never reaching the agent, because authenticated
calls go through a credential proxy that injects at the network edge; one
canonical runtime that produces the evaluation number; provider neutrality across
nine providers; learning that is measured by ablation or not claimed; a layered
architecture CI proves; a single datastore behind twelve repository ports; and
English throughout.

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](docs/site/quickstart/index.md): from nothing to a finished investigation, self-contained
- [Deployment](docs/site/deployment/index.md): the three profiles, upgrading, backup and restore, key rotation, air-gapped operation
- [Configuration reference](docs/site/configuration/index.md): every setting, generated from the settings catalogue
- [Capability reference](docs/site/capabilities/index.md): every tool and skill the agent may call, with the side-effect level each is gated at — generated from the declarations
- [Integration catalogue](docs/site/integrations/index.md): every vendor, its credential schema, and the permissions verification probes — generated from the catalogue
- [Security model](docs/site/security/index.md): the credential proxy, masking, guardrails, sandbox profiles, and the approval model, each with the threat it addresses
- [Evaluation methodology](docs/site/evaluation/index.md): the exact commands to reproduce every published number
- [Contributing](docs/site/contributing/index.md): tier table, file placement, conventions, and the seven artefacts every integration ships
